name: Light Sand Entire Primed Ceiling
intent: Full-ceiling fine sand of cured primer to flatten any nibs, lap lines, or dust inclusions before finish coats. Only required at QT4 and QT5; lower tiers rely on spot sanding from the inspect/repair module. Always followed by a vacuum dust pass before paint goes on. Slower than wall full-sand because of overhead position.
doctrine: Ceiling full sand at QT4 (400 SF/hr) is ~20% slower than wall full sand (500 SF/hr) due to overhead positioning. Vacuum rate matches wall vacuum (no overhead penalty for vacuuming with extension). QT5 sand slows further to 300 SF/hr because finer grit (220+) and tighter scrutiny demand slower travel.
